Subject: Request: temporary PO-gate reconsideration for pilot - FastPartners

Hi Vivek,

We're kicking off a short pilot (3 months) to evaluate Redwood for inference routing across a couple of our teams. The expected spend is modest — roughly $3k–4k / month — and our finance team prefers to proceed on invoice terms rather than set up a formal PO immediately.

Attached are our completed vendor onboarding form and a W9 to speed verification. If Redwood has concerns, we can sign a short addendum or provide a card-on-file for the first invoice.

Can your procurement team advise whether a temporary invoice-only path is possible for the pilot, and what evidence you need from us? We're aiming to start the week of June 21.

Thanks,
Dana Lopez
Head of Operations | FastPartners
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0173

Attachments: FastPartners_W9.pdf (application/pdf), Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary PO-gate reconsideration for pilot - FastPartners

Hi Dana — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the forms. Looping in Procurement (Priyom), Legal / Billing (Lauren) and Finance Ops (Naomi) to evaluate a temporary routing.

High level from my side: I'm sympathetic to a short invoice-only pilot if the total monthly run-rate remains low and we have a clear termination point. Priyom — could you review the attached W9 and onboarding form and confirm whether we can provide a 90-day invoice-only allowance for FP? If we need any security or accounting evidence beyond what Dana sent, please call it out.

If Procurement prefers, we can require a PO after the pilot or as soon as monthly run-rate exceeds an agreed threshold. Dana — can you confirm the entity (FastPartners, Inc. US entity) and the expected billing contact? That will speed routing.

Thanks — Vivek
VP, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Thanks Vivek / Dana — I reviewed the onboarding packet. A few clarifying items before Procurement can issue a temporary allowance: 

- Confirmed monthly estimate: please state expected monthly spend (exact or range). Our typical temporary invoice-only allowance is considered for <= $5,000/month during trial.
- Legal entity: confirm the billing entity (FastPartners, Inc. vs FastPartners EMEA).
- Accounting contact: name, email, and remit-to details.
- Taxes: W9 looks OK for US entity; if FP is EU-registered, we'll need a VAT certificate.
- Controls: if there will be sensitive data in requests, we need to verify acceptable data handling (SOC2/Security questionnaire).

If the answers align with the <= $5k/mo and US entity, Procurement can approve a 90-day invoice-only route with these conditions: monthly invoices, net-30 payment, and automatic PO requirement if rolling run-rate exceeds $5k for two consecutive months. I'll attach the internal allowlist request form to formalize.

Next steps for Dana: confirm the four bullets above and send accounting contact. Once we have that, I'll route for a one-time procurement exception and tag it to deal FP-2247.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Procurement_Allowlist_Request.pdf

From: Dana Lopez <dana@fastpartners.io>

Hi Priyom / Vivek — thanks for the quick review. Answers below: 

- Estimated monthly spend: ~$3,500 / month for the three-month pilot (likely lower in month 1).
- Billing entity: FastPartners, Inc. (US) — EIN included on the W9 you received.
- Accounting contact: Michael Burns <michael.burns@fastpartners.io>, +1 (415) 555-0110. Remit to: FastPartners, Inc., 210 Market St., Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105. Bank details attached.
- Data sensitivity: pilot traffic will be synthetic test data and anonymized production traces; we can complete Redwood's security questionnaire if helpful.

We are happy to accept the conditional allowance you proposed (90 days, monthly invoices, net-30, PO required if spend > $5k for two months). Please confirm and share any paperwork you need signed.

Also happy to run a 30-minute kickoff with your solutions team next week — Vivek, can you introduce the SRE/solutions contact when you're ready?

Best,
Dana Lopez
Head of Operations | FastPartners

Attachments: FP_bank_details.pdf
